get_recall.description: Get one recall by its number or its link on cpsc.gov: the products and how many were sold, the hazard, the remedy, injuries, the companies, where and when it was sold, countries of manufacture, UPCs, photos and how to contact the company.

mock_response.consumer_contact: Costway toll-free at 844-242-1885 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. PT Monday through Friday, email at recall@costway.com, or online at www.costway.com.
mock_response.description: This recall involves Costway high chairs designed to convert into a table and chair set. They were available in several color combinations, including purple and white, red and white, blue and white, and brown and white.
hazards: The convertible high chairs violate the mandatory safety standard for high chairs because they do not contain a passive restraint system and a child can slip through the opening between the feeding tray and seat and become entrapped or fall, posing a risk of serious injury or death.

images.caption: Recalled Costway High Chair (brown and white)
Recalled Costway High Chair (purple and white)

remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled high chairs and contact Costway for a free replacement high chair.
retailers: Walmart and Target stores nationwide and online at Costway.com from May 2023 through July 2026 for between $84 and $100.
Goplus Corporation, dba Costway, of Fontana, California
mock_response.title: Costway Recalls Convertible High Chairs Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Fall Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for High Chairs

parameters.description: The recall number shown on its page, such as 27-042 or 27042, or the link to the recall on cpsc.gov. 'Search recalls' gives it.

consumer_contact.description: How to reach the company about the recall: phone, hours, email and website.

description.description: What was recalled, as the CPSC describes it: the product, its colors and sizes, and where to find its model number.

manufactured_in.description: The countries it was made in, such as 'China'.

manufacturers.description: The companies that made it, with where they are.

name.description: The product's name, such as 'Costway Convertible High Chairs'.

type.description: The CPSC's product category, such as 'High Chairs'. Often empty for recent recalls.

units.description: How many were sold, as the CPSC words it, such as 'About 3,332'.

recall_date.description: The day the CPSC announced the recall, as YYYY-MM-DD.

recall_id.description: The CPSC's own number for the record, such as 11031.

recall_number.description: The recall number, such as '27042' (written 27-042 on cpsc.gov). 'Get a recall' takes it.

remedies.description: What owners should do, such as stop using it and contact the company for a refund or a free repair.

remedy_options.description: The kinds of remedy offered: Refund, Replace, Repair, New Instructions, Dispose, Label or Inspect.

retailers.description: Where it was sold, with the dates and prices, such as 'Amazon.com from March 2025 through August 2026 for about $13'. For many recent recalls the recalling company is listed here too.

title.description: The recall's headline, naming the company, the product and the hazard, such as 'Costway Recalls Convertible High Chairs Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Fall Hazards'.

upcs.description: The product's UPC barcodes, when the CPSC lists them.

recalls.consumer_contact: Lithonia Lighting toll-free at 855-307-2454 between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday.
recalls.description: This recall involves Luminaires with certain adjustable tilt mounting arms manufactured between August 2019 to July 2020 and August 2024 to April 2026: AASP, AARP, AAWB, and AAWSC.
hazards: The knuckle of the recalled adjustable tilt arm mountings can fail, allowing the luminaire to fall from the mounting arm, posing a risk of serious injury due to impact hazard.

images.caption: Recalled RSX Luminaire with an Adjustable Tilt Arm

injuries: The firm has received 13 reports of adjustable tilt arm mountings breaking. There have been four reports of the fixtures falling. No injuries have been reported.

products.name: Lithonia Lighting RSX Luminaires with AASP, AARP, AAWB, and AAWSC Adjustable Tilt Arm Mountings used for commercial outdoor lighting.

remedies: Consumers should keep clear of the area directly beneath the Luminaire and contact Lithonia Lighting to schedule a free repair.
retailers: Commercial distributors nationwide including Turtle & Hughes Inc. and Consolidated Electrical Distributors from August 2019 to August 2026 for between $400 and $2200.
recalls.title: Lithonia Lighting Recalls RSX Luminaires with Adjustable Tilt Arm Mountings Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Impact Hazard
